data.text:
Rizwan Khan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Food ... on 27 
February, 2024 
Author: Vivek Chaudhary
Bench: Vivek Chaudhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:17503-Db
Court No. - 2
Case :- Writ - C No. - 1945 of 2024
Petitioner :- Rizwan Khan
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Food Safety And Administration Deptt. Luck
Counsel for Petitioner :- Bal Krishna Shukla
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Sandeep Singh
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1.  Learned counsel for the petitioner prays to withdraw present writ petition with liberty to file a fresh petition at the appropriate stage with correct documents in case cause survives. 
2. Learned Standing Counsel for the State and Sri Sandeep Singh, learned counsel for respondent nos.3 and 4 have no objection to the same. 
3. With the aforesaid liberty, present writ petition is consigned to record as withdrawn. 
.
